scripts.predev: npm run build -w @flowtrade/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @flowtrade/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flowtrade/shared" "npm run dev -w @flowtrade/api" "npm run dev -w @flowtrade/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @flowtrade/shared && npm run dev -w @flowtrade/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowtrade/shared && npm run build -w @flowtrade/api && npm run build -w @flowtrade/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flowtrade/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flowtrade/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowtrade/web
